ConnectionStrings.UasuFinance: Set via `dotnet user-secrets set "ConnectionStrings:UasuFinance" "..."` in Development; override with the ConnectionStrings__UasuFinance environment variable in production.

EmailSettings._comment: Leave Host blank to run without a real mail server - SmtpEmailService logs the code instead of sending, and VerifyEmail shows it on-screen in Development. Set real values via user-secrets in Development or EmailSettings__* environment variables (Host/Port/EnableSsl/Username/Password/FromAddress/FromName) in production - never commit real SMTP credentials here.
